metadata.title: Blindboard Relay: code and evidence
metadata.description: Code and recorded evidence for Blindboard Relay: Measuring Model-Written Memory Across Amnesiac Turns. Includes the reset protocol, text and pixel channels, budget-matched reference, raw recorded episodes, calibration artifacts, analysis, tests and manuscript. Measurements use public development seeds at one reasoning effort per model. Original-model controls differ in collection date; the paper identifies same-day fresh-seed replications separately.
metadata.notes: Code is Apache 2.0; data and documentation are CC BY 4.0. The Blindboard dependency preserves its released provenance and licences.
